biocs.name: Uncommon Linux Remote Shell Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of unusual shell command execution patterns that are commonly seen in lateral movement or remote access scenarios
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/shell.sh'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
